Hi Emma / Tom — thanks again for taking the time today. Wanted to capture a concise recap and explicit next steps so we’re aligned. If I missed anything, please flag edits inline.

Quick TL;DR
- Primary driver: regulated clinical research workflows (PHI) + EU trial node in Q1 ’27 -> customer requires an on‑prem or VPC private deployment with air‑gap posture for the clinical environment.
- Key networking constraint: no internet egress from the clinical cluster; only approved peering to a hardened ops jumpbox allowed for maintenance.
- Security asks: KMS/HSM integration, SIEM log forwarding to customer Splunk, full audit logs retention for 3 years, and support for FIPS-validated crypto.
- Success criteria for pilot: run inference within the clinical network (no tokens leave), avg inference latency <= 250ms for 1k concurrent sessions, and a secure model-update workflow.

Summary of what we discussed
1) Deployment model options we reviewed: o Hosted with private peering (not acceptable for the clinical node as described), o Dedicated in RedNet VPC with strict routing (may still have egress concerns), o On‑prem appliance or customer-managed cluster running Redwood Private (recommended path).
2) Network topology constraints: Halcyon clinical cluster must not have any 0.0.0.0/0 outbound. Maintenance connectivity allowed only from a fixed ops jumpbox via an approved port list.
3) Data residency: EU trial data MUST remain in EU jurisdiction; we discussed a staged pilot where inference for EU trial runs on a regional on‑prem blade in Dublin.
4) Integrations: KMS (HashiCorp / Azure Key Vault), SAML for SSO, and SOC2 evidence for backups.

Action items (owners & timing)
- Halcyon: share the clinical network diagram and a list of approved maintenance jumpbox IPs — Emma/Tom (by 2026-10-08).
- Redwood: draft a short tech-runbook describing the on‑prem install footprint, HSM/KMS options, and required firewall rules — Ben (by 2026-10-09).
- Security questionnaire: Redwood will send the completed security spreadsheet and SOC2 artifact checklist — Soojin (today).
- Schedule: propose a 90‑minute infra workshop next week to walk Networking and InfoSec (aim 2026-10-12 / 10-14).

Attachments I’m including: basic network sketch (halcyon-network-sketch.pdf) and our redwood-security-questions.xlsx — these are stubs; Ben will follow with more detailed install sizing.

Thanks — looking forward to the workshop.

Regards,

- KMS: we support HSM-backed keys; recommend customer-hosted Key Vault with RBAC mapping.
